venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Saturday 11/14 (MOD JK; entered by Mya; posted 2:47am 11/15)** Net $8,689 vs target $8,492 (102%). Food $571; comps $92.70 (1.1%). 293 guests; check avg $29.66. Great Saturday to close the week — push right at doors open; big birthday party celebrated (offer group activities, tell them about the DJ). DJ Jean Angelo from 9pm, great sound and adapts well to feedback; lots of familiar faces; investor UV brought friends. Reminders: pursue excellence with garnishes (mint storage on damp napkins); 1:1s in freezer Collins, martinis in coupes per spec. Kitchen smooth. Low: diet, noon, Pathfinder, Oktoberfest, Fernet; 86: Diplomatico, Patrón Silver, shorty service. No maintenance; no incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Saturday 11/14 (MOD KE, Chef Amanda; entered by BT; posted 3:53am 11/15)** Net $13,545 vs target $9,857 (137%). Event $2,000 (partial buyout of the pit, ~6:30–11pm); food $241; comps $151 (1.1%). 390 guests; check avg $29.60. Podcast anniversary celebration in the booths 7–11pm. Busy 9:30pm–1:30am with big pops ~10:30 and 11; mostly first-time guests plus a handful of regulars; DJ leaned into dance tracks and guests danced. Kitchen: Amanda did great. 86: Ponies; low: pilsner. No maintenance; no incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Saturday 11/14 (AM MOD Maggie H; PM MOD Maggie S; entered by MS; posted 4:34am 11/15)** Net $31,425.23 incl. events; daily target reported 'x' (n/a). AM (coffee) $2,658, D&C PM $13,954. Net event sales $12,944 (event food $7,182, bev $5,110). Food incl. events $10,659 (non-event $3,477). Comps $696 (2.2%; big comp for Mr. Schlacks plus a tab rung in twice by accident, voided). 437 guests (Tock); check avg $71.91 (net incl. events / guests). Busy start to finish: AM nearly sold out of food, even split coffee/cocktails; cold brew ready 9am. PM 'wild and whacky' — big early-afternoon pop, more reservations than ideal, 400+ guests. Event: Blair & Michael wedding ceremony/reception, 49 guests, 4–9pm Garden/Vauxhall, family-style dinner (Lucas W, Rand, Sam) — couple thanked the team. Kitchen busy (Emma, FL). Break make-up not complete. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Cosette's farewell.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Saturday 11/14 (MOD Kyler, Chef Michael; entered by Thomas; posted 3:23am 11/15)** Net $8,882 vs target $7,922 (112%). Food $723, beverage $8,159; no events; comps $209.17 (2.4%; members, investors, gifts, past/present employees). 228 guests (SevenRooms); check avg $38.96 (net/guests; form $39). Light reservations at open but a walk-in line to the record store; waitlist from 6:30pm, cooled ~9:30pm, surprise second wave at 11:45pm; last group called back at 1:35am. 4 large parties, 10 solos, 12 investor cocktails; bachelorette party, courthouse newlyweds, anniversaries, birthdays, lots of LA visitors. Two badly timed cancels; 2 no-shows (not charged). Top sellers: Burner Phone, Rosalie, Shinebox. Menu count 20. Breakage: 1 sidecar.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Saturday 11/14 (MOD Gigi/Joe, Chefs Josh/Angel/Saleh; entered by Joe; posted 11:00am ET 11/15)** Net $13,426 vs target $13,604 (98.7%). Marquee $9,970; Standing Room $3,456. Food $2,362; comps $475 (3.5%; Sheyla, Kevin, birthdays, anniversaries, investors, staff food, lots of DNL, a walkout). 367 guests; check avg $36.58 (net/guests — form reported $96.59, which doesn't reconcile with net). Very busy Saturday: 150 covers on the books and a strong start; Marquee full before 7pm just as Standing Room opened; constant traffic start to finish with many regulars and first-timers; lots of large-party walk-ins the team creatively accommodated. Chelsea and Nogen held Marquee and wowed guests with off-menu drinks. Kitchen busy but handled it with ease. Weather field answered 'No'. No incidents; no-shows charged. Favorite moment: seeing many regulars stop by.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Saturday 11/14 (MOD Josh; entered by Josh; posted 10:56am ET 11/15)** Net $10,866.55 (form 'Total Net Sales Including Events') vs target $10,163 (106.9%). Marquee bar $9,483.05, Garden $1,713; total sales $11,196.05; food $1,110; comps $329.50, voids $40. 224 guests; check avg $48.51 (net/guests; form GCA $39.37, CA $85.09). Garden quiet early, picked up ~9:30pm with larger parties; hit a 30-min wait, moved most guests inside (two groups opted out); last call pushed to midnight. Marquee busy with short lulls — date nights, celebrations, girls' nights; strong bar teamwork on ticket passing and rounds; need more consistency on water service and glassware resets. Two servers handled the floor well, but need sharper attention to detail (ringing items correctly, clearing KDS, double-checking checks) — came close to closing the wrong tab. Kitchen: bigger late push from larger parties; oysters and franks popular; both chefs on the line, food out quickly. ABRA officer visit — all operations in good order. Kitchen close not checked. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Maintenance: curtains.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Saturday 11/14 (AM Sam & Lex; PM James & Marcus; entered by Alexis; posted 2:22am 11/15)** Net $20,373 vs target $16,202 (126%). Morning bar $6,120, evening bar $11,419, Hot Eye $2,810; Sun Club closed; no events; food $7,207; comps $377 (1.9%). 442 guests (167 AM + 275 PM OpenTable); check avg $46.09 (net/guests). Busy morning with visitors in town for races, food tours and Philharmonic concerts. Evening happy hour slower than expected as the half marathon wrapped up, picked up ~5pm; Philharmonic show across the street brought big rushes before and after, guests trickled out past close with minimal support. Hot Eye busy early, long lull, then crushed for a couple hours; local guests and a late industry pop. Kitchen smooth; low citrus and frisée (in tomorrow). No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Saturday 11/14 (MOD Curtis; entered by Belle; posted 4:38am 11/15)** Net $11,473 vs target $11,610 (99%). Event $1,480 (private wedding cocktail reception, opened early 3–4:30pm); food $1,233; comps $107.97 (0.9%; 2 DNL/service recoveries, community members, friends from next door). 200 guests; check avg $55.78. Reopened for regular service 5:30pm with nearly 50 covers seated in the first 30 minutes; steady all evening with a second push ~10pm; early cuts on floor and bar; staggered scheduling continues to work. Kitchen smooth. 86/low: Fernet. Nothing new on maintenance; no incidents; no-shows charged.
